title: Einstein-Lovelock field equations for a4[x4] in the primordial metric (Revision/SPEC.md section 5)

conventions.coordinates: x1, x2, x3 = 3-space (scale factor e^{a4} sin^{1/6} z); x4 = time; x5, x6, x7 = extra times, time-like, deflating (scale factor e^{-a4} sin^{1/6} z); x8 = hidden direction, z = 6 H x8 in (0, pi/2)
conventions.symbols: ad1 = a4'(x4), ad2 = a4''(x4), H > 0, alpha1..alpha3 = Lovelock couplings, Lam = Lambda, kappa = gravitational coupling, cc = cot z; d4f, d8f = partial derivatives of f with respect to x4, x8
conventions.curvature: MTW: R^a_{bcd} = d_c Gamma^a_{bd} - d_d Gamma^a_{bc} + Gamma^a_{ce} Gamma^e_{bd} - Gamma^a_{de} Gamma^e_{bc}
conventions.fieldEquations: sum_{k=1}^{3} alpha_k E_(k)^mu_nu + Lam delta^mu_nu = kappa T^mu_nu
conventions.source: T^mu_nu = diag(p3, p3, p3, -rho, p_t, p_t, p_t, p8) + q48 (mu = x4, nu = x8) + q84 (mu = x8, nu = x4); rho = -T^x4_x4, p_mu = T^mu_mu (no sum)

lovelockTensors.allOtherComponents: x2x2 = x3x3 = x1x1, x6x6 = x7x7 = x5x5, every other off-diagonal component 0 (exact, all 64 components checked)

generalSource.offDiagonal_other: 0 = kappa T^mu_nu for every other mu != nu (the left-hand sides vanish identically)
generalSource.x8_dependence: the left-hand sides are free of x8 (and of a4 itself), so the source must satisfy d8 rho = d8 p3 = d8 p_t = d8 p8 = 0 and q48 = q84 = 0: every mixed component of T is a function of x4 alone; an x8-dependent source is not compatible with the metric of SPEC section 1

conservation_x4.tex: -3 (a_4') p_3+3 (a_4') p_t-\frac{6 H q_{84}}{\cot z}-\partial_4 \rho+\partial_8 q_{84} = 0

conservation_x8.tex: \cot z (-3 H p_3+6 H p_8-3 H p_t)+\partial_4 q_{48}+\partial_8 p_8 = 0

generalSource.conservation_reduced: with an x8-independent source and q48 = q84 = 0: rho' = -3 a4' (p3 - p_t) (x4 component) and p3 + p_t = 2 p8 (x8 component), both implied by the field equations (Bianchi identity)
generalSource.constraint_propagation: d/dx4 (constraint) = 3 a4' (evolution) once rho' = -3 a4' (p3 - p_t) is used (constraint: sum_k alpha_k E^x4_x4 + Lam + kappa rho = 0; evolution: a4'' F - kappa (p3 - p_t) = 0); so for a4' != 0 the evolution equation follows from the constraint and rho' = -3 a4' (p3 - p_t); the x8 equation is an independent first-order relation

rho.tex: -\frac{360 (a_4')^6 \alpha_3}{\kappa }+\frac{36 (a_4')^4 \alpha_2}{\kappa }-\frac{648 (a_4')^4 \alpha_3 H^2}{\kappa }-\frac{3 (a_4')^2 \alpha_1}{\kappa }+\frac{120 (a_4')^2 \alpha_2 H^2}{\kappa }-\frac{1080 (a_4')^2 \alpha_3 H^4}{\kappa }-\frac{21 \alpha_1 H^2}{\kappa }+\frac{420 \alpha_2 H^4}{\kappa }-\frac{2520 \alpha_3 H^6}{\kappa }-\frac{\Lambda}{\kappa }

p3.tex: -\frac{72 (a_4')^6 \alpha_3}{\kappa }+\frac{360 (a_4')^4 a_4'' \alpha_3}{\kappa }+\frac{12 (a_4')^4 \alpha_2}{\kappa }-\frac{648 (a_4')^4 \alpha_3 H^2}{\kappa }-\frac{24 (a_4')^2 a_4'' \alpha_2}{\kappa }+\frac{432 (a_4')^2 a_4'' \alpha_3 H^2}{\kappa }-\frac{3 (a_4')^2 \alpha_1}{\kappa }+\frac{168 (a_4')^2 \alpha_2 H^2}{\kappa }-\frac{1944 (a_4')^2 \alpha_3 H^4}{\kappa }+\frac{a_4'' \alpha_1}{\kappa }-\frac{40 a_4'' \alpha_2 H^2}{\kappa }+\frac{360 a_4'' \alpha_3 H^4}{\kappa }+\frac{15 \alpha_1 H^2}{\kappa }-\frac{180 \alpha_2 H^4}{\kappa }+\frac{360 \alpha_3 H^6}{\kappa }+\frac{\Lambda}{\kappa }

pt.tex: -\frac{72 (a_4')^6 \alpha_3}{\kappa }-\frac{360 (a_4')^4 a_4'' \alpha_3}{\kappa }+\frac{12 (a_4')^4 \alpha_2}{\kappa }-\frac{648 (a_4')^4 \alpha_3 H^2}{\kappa }+\frac{24 (a_4')^2 a_4'' \alpha_2}{\kappa }-\frac{432 (a_4')^2 a_4'' \alpha_3 H^2}{\kappa }-\frac{3 (a_4')^2 \alpha_1}{\kappa }+\frac{168 (a_4')^2 \alpha_2 H^2}{\kappa }-\frac{1944 (a_4')^2 \alpha_3 H^4}{\kappa }-\frac{a_4'' \alpha_1}{\kappa }+\frac{40 a_4'' \alpha_2 H^2}{\kappa }-\frac{360 a_4'' \alpha_3 H^4}{\kappa }+\frac{15 \alpha_1 H^2}{\kappa }-\frac{180 \alpha_2 H^4}{\kappa }+\frac{360 \alpha_3 H^6}{\kappa }+\frac{\Lambda}{\kappa }

p8.tex: -\frac{72 (a_4')^6 \alpha_3}{\kappa }+\frac{12 (a_4')^4 \alpha_2}{\kappa }-\frac{648 (a_4')^4 \alpha_3 H^2}{\kappa }-\frac{3 (a_4')^2 \alpha_1}{\kappa }+\frac{168 (a_4')^2 \alpha_2 H^2}{\kappa }-\frac{1944 (a_4')^2 \alpha_3 H^4}{\kappa }+\frac{15 \alpha_1 H^2}{\kappa }-\frac{180 \alpha_2 H^4}{\kappa }+\frac{360 \alpha_3 H^6}{\kappa }+\frac{\Lambda}{\kappa }

einstein.noVacuum: T = 0 has no solution for H > 0 and any Lambda (x4 + x8 components: 36 H^2 + 2 Lambda = 0; x4 - x8: 6 a4'^2 + 6 H^2 = 0)
einstein.allowedA4: every C^2 function a4(x4) is allowed, with the source fixed by sourceRequiredByGivenA4 (alpha1 = 1, alpha2 = alpha3 = 0); kappa rho > 0 needs Lambda < -(3 a4'^2 + 21 H^2), and kappa (rho + p8) = -6 (a4'^2 + H^2) < 0 always

linearMember.a4: a4 = A H x4 + a0 (ad1 = A H, ad2 = 0): 3-space scale factor e^{A H x4}, extra-time scale factor e^{-A H x4} (exponential deflation for A > 0)
linearMember.requiredSource: rho, p3 = p_t = p8 = p constants (any alpha_k); A is any real number, the source being fixed by A through rho and p below

rho.tex: -\frac{360 A^6 \alpha_3 H^6}{\kappa }+\frac{36 A^4 \alpha_2 H^4}{\kappa }-\frac{648 A^4 \alpha_3 H^6}{\kappa }-\frac{3 A^2 \alpha_1 H^2}{\kappa }+\frac{120 A^2 \alpha_2 H^4}{\kappa }-\frac{1080 A^2 \alpha_3 H^6}{\kappa }-\frac{21 \alpha_1 H^2}{\kappa }+\frac{420 \alpha_2 H^4}{\kappa }-\frac{2520 \alpha_3 H^6}{\kappa }-\frac{\Lambda}{\kappa }

p.tex: -\frac{72 A^6 \alpha_3 H^6}{\kappa }+\frac{12 A^4 \alpha_2 H^4}{\kappa }-\frac{648 A^4 \alpha_3 H^6}{\kappa }-\frac{3 A^2 \alpha_1 H^2}{\kappa }+\frac{168 A^2 \alpha_2 H^4}{\kappa }-\frac{1944 A^2 \alpha_3 H^6}{\kappa }+\frac{15 \alpha_1 H^2}{\kappa }-\frac{180 \alpha_2 H^4}{\kappa }+\frac{360 \alpha_3 H^6}{\kappa }+\frac{\Lambda}{\kappa }

vacuumCondition.tex: 6 \left(A^2+1\right) H^2 \left(72 A^4 \alpha_3 H^4-8 A^2 \alpha_2 H^2+144 A^2 \alpha_3 H^4+\alpha_1-40 \alpha_2 H^2+360 \alpha_3 H^4\right) = 0

vacuumFactor.tex: 72 A^4 \alpha_3 H^4-8 A^2 \alpha_2 H^2+144 A^2 \alpha_3 H^4+\alpha_1-40 \alpha_2 H^2+360 \alpha_3 H^4

linearMember.einsteinGaussBonnetVacuum: alpha3 = 0, alpha1 = 1: A^2 = (1 - 40 alpha2 H^2)/(8 alpha2 H^2), real A iff 0 < alpha2 H^2 <= 1/40; Lambda = -sum_k alpha_k E_(k)^x4_x4 at a4' = A H

lemmas.gravityTerm: gamma^mu Omega_mu = 3 H gamma^x8 (canonical spin connection; Omega_x4 = Omega_x8 = 0)
lemmas.diagonalKinetic: {gamma^mu, Omega_mu} = 0 for each mu (no sum), so K^mu_mu = (1/2)(Psibar gamma^mu d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^mu Psi) contains no spin connection; for a configuration independent of x_mu, K^mu_mu = 0
lemmas.traceOnShell: sum_mu K^mu_mu = (m + U'(S)) S on shell (both statistics), so the on-shell Lagrangian is L = S U'(S) - U(S)

fields.emtConvention: T^mu_nu = sigmaT ( -K^(mu_nu) + delta^mu_nu L ), K^mu_nu = (1/2)(Psibar gamma^mu D_nu Psi - D_nu Psibar gamma^mu Psi), symmetrised; sigmaT = +1 is the convention of SPEC section 4 (homogeneous on-shell states: rho = m S + U, p = S U' - U); if the vielbein variation of the theory branch fixes the opposite overall sign, set sigmaT = -1 everywhere

generalFormulas.kmu: k_mu = K^mu_mu (no sum) = (1/2)(Psibar gamma^mu d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^mu Psi); L = k1+k2+k3+k4+k5+k6+k7+k8 - m S - U(S) (on shell S U'(S) - U(S))
generalFormulas.evolution: a4'' F(a4') = kappa sigmaT ( k5 - k1 )
generalFormulas.offDiagonal: T^mu_nu = -sigmaT K^(mu_nu) for mu != nu must vanish (0 = kappa T^mu_nu); for the homogeneous condensate these are the 15 three-gamma bilinears listed under dirac16complex00.offDiagonalKinetic
generalFormulas.algebraic: 2 k8 = k1 + k5 (from p3 + p_t = 2 p8)

dirac16complex00.statement: classical commuting Phi; k_mu, S, U are classical bilinears
dirac16complex00.homogeneousCondensate: Phi = Phi(x4) on shell, independent of x1..x3, x5..x8 (d4 Phi = A Phi, A = -gamma^x4 (M - 3 H gamma^x8), M = m + U'(S)): S = Phibar Phi is constant (exact); the diagonal kinetic components are K^x4_x4 = M S and 0 for every other direction, and K^x4_x8 = 0; hence rho = sigmaT (m S + U(S)), p3 = p_t = p8 = sigmaT (S U'(S) - U(S)), q48 = q84 = 0
dirac16complex00.offDiagonalConditions: the off-diagonal field equations 0 = kappa T^mu_nu (mu != nu, not x4-x8) require the 15 bilinears B_abc = Phibar gamma^a gamma^b gamma^c Phi (frame gammas) to vanish: B_{i x4 x8} = 0 for i = x1..x3, x5..x7 (coefficients proportional to H and to a4'), and, when a4' != 0, B_{i j x4} = 0 for i = x1..x3, j = x5..x7
dirac16complex00.offDiagonalWitness: exact solutions with all 15 bilinears zero and S != 0 exist: Phi = e^{-i w x4} Phi0, w = sqrt(M^2 - 9 H^2) (M^2 > 9 H^2), Phi0 = v1 + c v2 from the two A-eigenvectors with gamma^x1 gamma^x5 = gamma^x2 gamma^x6 = gamma^x3 gamma^x7 = -1 and +1, c = conj(v1^dagger C v2); checked exactly at (M, H) = (5, 1), (5, 4/3), (-5, 1) (wolfram report, condensate_diagonal_witness_exact)
dirac16complex00.theoremLinear: Hypotheses: Phi a homogeneous on-shell condensate as above (classical, commuting), satisfying the off-diagonal conditions, a4 in C^2, (alpha1, alpha2, alpha3) != (0,0,0). Then p3 = p_t, so a4'' F(a4') = 0; F is a nonzero polynomial with finitely many roots, a4' is continuous, so a4'' = 0 on every interval: a4 = A H x4 + a0 (linear) with real A. The equations contain A only through A^2 (invariant under A -> -A): the extra times deflate for A > 0, which is a choice of sign (an initial condition), not selected by the equations; A < 0 (inflating extra times) is allowed on the same footing and A = 0 is the static case
dirac16complex00.einsteinConditions: kappa sigmaT (m S + U) = -(3 A^2 + 21) H^2 - Lambda and kappa sigmaT (S U' - U) = (15 - 3 A^2) H^2 + Lambda
dirac16complex00.einsteinQuadraticU: U = (lambda/2) S^2, m != 0: kappa sigmaT m S = -(36 H^2 + 2 Lambda) and A^2 = -kappa sigmaT S (m + lambda S)/(6 H^2) - 1 (real A needs kappa sigmaT S (m + lambda S) <= -6 H^2)
dirac16complex00.lovelockConditions: kappa sigmaT (m S + U) = -(Lam + sum_k alpha_k E_(k)^x4_x4) and kappa sigmaT (S U' - U) = Lam + sum_k alpha_k E_(k)^x8_x8, both at a4' = A H (linearMember.rho, linearMember.p)

dirac16complex.statement: quantised Psi (SPEC section 6): every bilinear is replaced by the expectation value of the normal-ordered operator in the state, <:k_mu:>, <:S:>, <:U(S):> (note <U(S)> != U(<S>) in general); the trace identity sum_mu <:k_mu:> = <:(m + U'(S)) S:> for the normal-ordered operators of the field on a whole slice is ASSUMED here, not proved. It is decided only in a finite model, by Revision/theory/fock_quartic (reports/fock-quartic.json, 21/21 PASS: one good-sector plane-wave mode set with frozen coefficients, flat frame, volume 1, 16 modes, 2^16 states, U = (lambda/2) S^2 with symbolic lambda): there, for the Heisenberg field of the interacting operator field equation, it is an exact operator identity on every state if the potential in the Hamiltonian and the products in the energy-momentum tensor are both Wick (normal) ordered, and it fails, also in expectation values, for every other tested combination (three other orderings of the potential, vacuum subtraction instead of Wick products, the other right-hand side); at k = 0 the homogeneous values rho = :m S + U: and p = :S U' - U: are operator identities in the same Wick sense, with <:U(S):> != U(<:S:>). Nothing is proved for the field on a whole slice (many momenta), for the curved x8 dependence with its boundary term at z = pi/2, or for the extra-time sector
dirac16complex.evolution: a4'' F(a4') = kappa sigmaT ( <:k5:> - <:k1:> ): a state with <:k1:> != <:k5:> would drive a4'' if it also met the remaining conditions (p3 + p_t = 2 p8, every expectation value independent of x8, off-diagonal components zero); no such state is constructed in Revision
dirac16complex.kohnSham: to be filled by Revision/kohn_sham: rho_KS(x4), p3_KS(x4), p_t_KS(x4), p8_KS(x4) from the occupied Kohn-Sham orbitals (with the Hartree and exchange terms); then constraint: sum_k alpha_k E_(k)^x4_x4 + Lam = -kappa rho_KS; evolution: a4'' F(a4') = kappa (p3_KS - p_t_KS); x8: sum_k alpha_k E_(k)^x8_x8 + Lam = kappa p8_KS; conditions: p3_KS + p_t_KS = 2 p8_KS, the x4-x8 component zero, and every component independent of x8 (a Kohn-Sham source with an x8 profile satisfies the equations only if these hold; otherwise the metric of SPEC section 1 is not an exact solution with that source). Evaluated on the recorded Kohn-Sham states (Revision/field_equations_a4/reports/ks-source-conditions.json): every nonzero ground state depends on x8 and violates p3 + p_t = 2 p8 pointwise and after integration over x8, so none is an admissible source; the Kohn-Sham history a4 = A H x4 is a PRESCRIBED test-field background without back-reaction (the linear member needs p3 = p_t = p8 and constant rho, which the Kohn-Sham gas does not have)
dirac16complex.offDiagonal: every off-diagonal expectation value <:T^mu_nu:> (mu != nu) must vanish, in particular the expectation values of the 15 three-gamma bilinears for a homogeneous state
dirac16complex.homogeneousSingleMode: if a state has <:k1:> = <:k5:> (e.g. all quanta at zero 3- and extra-time momentum), for every x4 (and the off-diagonal conditions hold), then a4'' F(a4') = 0 and the argument of the dirac16complex00 theorem gives a4 = A H x4 + a0 with real A (A -> -A is a symmetry of the equations; the sign of A is not selected)
